title: Project Documentation Artifacts
subtitle: Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, User Stories, Business Process Architecture, Network Topology, Information Security, Technical Solution Design
statusTitle: Status of this document — AS-BUILT, with a forward backlog
statusBody: Everything marked Done in this document was verified against source in hims-app/ at v2.20.2. Everything marked Open is not implemented and is named as such rather than described as though it exists.

The three as-built references — HIMS_ARCHITECTURE_AND_SECURITY.md, HIMS_SYSTEM_DOCUMENTATION.md and HIMS_USER_GUIDE.md — describe only what the code does. Where a requested part is already covered there, this document summarises it and points at the owning section instead of restating it. The reference map below says which parts those are.

referenceMap.intro: The brief asked for seven parts. Three of them were already documented in the repository, so they are summarised here for self-containment and cross-referenced to the authority. Four were not documented anywhere and are authored here for the first time.

Process steps exist (HIMS_SYSTEM_DOCUMENTATION.md §4.A–§4.G and §8 Sample Workflow). The architecture above them — process taxonomy, ownership, swimlanes, cross-process invariants — did not, and is authored here.
